parameters.name: AgentIds
parameters.description: List of agent IDs separated by commas (","). The agent ID is equivalent to the RAM Sub-account ID of the agent. A maximum of 50 agents is allowed. If this parameter is not specified, all agents are queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: End date, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Note that queries are currently supported only at the day dimension. For parameter settings, refer to the examples.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID of the call center

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Page size. Default value is 10, and the maximum is 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Start date, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Note that queries are currently supported only at the day dimension. For parameter settings, refer to the examples. Additionally, the specified time must not be earlier than six months ago.
